Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 5, Verse 10

“One who acts, offering all actions to Brahman and abandoning attachment, is not touched by wrong — as a lotus leaf is untouched by water.”

The lotus leaf is the Gita's finest image for engaged detachment. The leaf sits in the water, not above it; contact happens constantly and nothing soaks in.
